summary: The prose fixes themselves are correct and complete: the modern-app-dev bar is met, and every rewritten README claim (five bind-mounts, six iac-controller jobs and their charters, the pod-agent split, the corrected design link) verifies against the working tree, with no executable line changed. One Major: the phase's own py_compile gate step left support/iac-agent/bin/__pycache__/send_message.cpython-313.pyc in the tree — gitignored, so invisible to git status — and the role's synchronize excludes only .git with delete:true, so the operator's R6 parity apply itemizes a brand-new dir plus file (reproduced) instead of PB's timestamp-only signal, and drops a stale .pyc on srviac. Three Minor advisories: an iac-prune comment citing a docker pull iac never runs, two surviving dead AnsibleSpecs pointers (one in a file this commit edited), and an error message naming an srviac-only path the README's documented wrkdev parity case lacks.
